stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The shoes were still good, but they needed time to become part of her running.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Others feel better after silence.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The shoes were still good, but they needed time to become part of her running. No shortcut can replace preparation.」，答案為「No shortcut can replace preparation.」。
